source: Direct human request in Boxer chat 01a103aa-7cc7-7040-8c7f-14acbada68cc
quote: We need to refine this engine. Key details is that there should be two modes, one on a phone, where the edges of the screen will control the gloves, and one for tablet where the gloves are independently controlled. The next thing we need is a collission engine for the gloves and the targets, guard is a huge part of this game, learning to block the shots that are coming at you. If you have your gloves in the path, it should be blocked, no matter where it is. Once this engine is built, stress test it extensively.
interpretation: Phone uses visible left/right edge drag bays; tablet uses directly claimed individual gloves. Both retain sticky ownership and sequential one-finger completion.

Physical contact, including stationary held guard, blocks a travelling punch at every point before player contact. This replaces the fixed guard-point test and any earlier motion-only swat restriction.
Contact does not grant passive rewards. Only deliberate owned guards and real forward strikes bank work through the career world.

Reuse the existing independently authored painted gloves and targets. No new artwork, protected voice changes, save schema, first-to-six bout redesign or release is part of this focused engine repair.
